title: 'World of Dinosaurs' Skirt
content: Bethany has come up with a nifty skirt tutorial using fabric based on myWorld of Dinosaurspostage stamp artwork:"I wanted to make a skirt out of it in the past but kept hesitating because I couldn't see myself wearing dinosaurs around town. But now I'm more awesome."Bethany's "World of Dinosaurs" skirt tutorialJames Gurney: The World of Dinosaurs
